concepts.gloss_en: When a person desires (yearns) all the more — the principle that intensified longing empowers one to overcome obstacles

members.note: same clause from the identical passage in lm1:66; longer form just appends 'according to the obstacle', spelling out the proportionality already implicit — same referent

notes: Both forms cite the exact same sentence in Torah 66; the longer form is a fuller quotation of the same phrase, not a distinct concept.
